lessons_used: Fast-track adoption flows and moving sign-in after pet adoption were helpful.
Photo quality callouts, interactive tip carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight layouts on the final welcome screen, background notification prompts, and account sync copy banners showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for initial flow changes and non-significant tests, but were too low for visual callouts, progress carousels, and path selection screens.

candidates.title: First Interaction Playground Screen
candidates.change: Adds a hands-on playground screen right before final completion to let users practice dragging and interacting with their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support mail shows users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails) and completion drops to 64.8% at finish.

new_pet_playground.headline: Try Out Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_playground.body: Practice clicking, dragging, and hovering over your new pet before placing it on your desktop.

components.text: Drag pet to move, right-click for controls menu.

guard.reason: Adds a new playground screen after home_intro, which is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest funnel drop (35.2% at finish) with support emails, but adding a new screen carries implementation friction.

candidates.title: Stage-Based Pet Adoption Studio
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live sound previews of pet voices.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.9% with a median duration of 89s, and users reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches (3 emails).

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet and listen to their voice personality preview.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a sound cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Placement
candidates.change: Moves account sign-in to take place right after completing the pet adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Signing in early creates hesitation (78.3% sign_in conversion), and 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet adoption certificate and sync across desktop devices.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step after adoption certificate, explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in post-adoption aligns with proven lessons and directly addresses top support complaint (8 emails).

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Introduces display and window overlay diagnostic checks on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
candidates.why: Waiting/home steps take a very long time (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app refusing to open.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Canvas
waiting.body: Verifying screen overlay permissions and graphic acceleration while your pet wakes up.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen while keeping its required function.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high wait times and desktop rendering issues, but complex flow additions saw muted historical gains.

candidates.title: Path Decision Speed Helper Callout
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the path selection screen reassuring users that they can alter their path anytime in app settings.
candidates.why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating severe long-tail hesitation.

choose_path.hint: You can switch between custom generation and preset adoption anytime in settings.

guard.reason: Adds helpful text callout to choose_path screen without altering required jobs.

candidates.score_note: Path selection callouts and hints perform very well, and simple hint callout is low cost (config/UI only).

candidates.title: Pet Personality Micro-Activities During Wait
candidates.change: Adds an interactive tip carousel with pet care tips while the pet assets render in the background.
candidates.why: Home wait time is very high (mean 2336s) contributing to the low 25.5% overall onboarding completion rate.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
waiting.body: Flip through fun desktop pet tips while we finish setting up your pet's animations.

guard.reason: Adds interactive tips during the wait screen while pet is rendered.

candidates.score_note: Interactive tip carousels during wait times are proven effective (+7.8% historical lift on wait_info).

candidates.title: Account Persistence Safeguard Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly state that local pet data automatically attaches to the account without loss.
candidates.why: The top support theme with 8 emails concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Your pet progress automatically attaches to this account so your companions are never lost or reset.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to clarify data persistence without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Config-only change with strong email evidence, but copy-only changes show weak historical conversion lift (+1.9%).

candidates.title: Adoption Completion Audio Bell Alert
candidates.change: Enables audio notifications and a audio chime component when pet rendering completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High mean wait times (2336s on home, 5815s on finish) indicate users walk away while waiting for adoption completion.

guard.reason: Adds completion audio alert to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Notification prompts showed no clear effect in lessons, yielding modest gains (+3.4% historical).

candidates.title: Two-Column Adoption Certificate Preview Layout
candidates.change: Switches adoption certificate screen layout to a two-column display highlighting pet traits side-by-side with signature area.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.9%, the second biggest drop in the main funnel.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet's attributes and sign below to complete adoption.

guard.reason: Asks the user to sign, which requests personal information

candidates.title: First-Day Accessory Unlock Badge Callout
candidates.change: Displays a reward badge on the final welcome screen offering an exclusive starter collar accessory for completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 25.5%, and finish step completion drops to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! Starter Reward Unlocked
home_intro.body: Your pet is live on your desktop! You've unlocked the Golden Collar accessory for completing setup.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions starter rewards/unlocked accessories (gifts/free extras), violating Rule 3.

lessons_next: Preset fast-track adoption flows, photo quality callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, post-adoption certificate sign-in placement, and desktop diagnostic flows showed no clear effect.
Path decision speed helper callouts performed worse than the control.
Predictions were too low for visual callouts, interactive progress carousels, and split-view path selection screens.
Predictions were too high for flow restructuring, sign-in reordering, non-significant tests, and changes that worsened performance.
